flatland.configuration.title: Flatland
flatland.configuration.worldgen.tooltip: World generation. Changes only affect chunks that have not been generated yet.
flatland.configuration.worldgen.replace_: Biome ids converted into flatland. Unknown ids are ignored.
flatland.configuration.worldgen.flat_hei: Y of the top solid block. 62 keeps the ground flush with sea level.
flatland.configuration.worldgen.flat_str: 0 keeps vanilla terrain, 100 makes the converted area perfectly flat.
AUTO picks by the replaced biome's temperature: cold -> snowy, hot -> sandy, otherwise temperate.
flatland.configuration.worldgen.spawn_pr: Move the world spawn into flatland once, when a brand-new world is created. Existing worlds are left untouched.
flatland.configuration.worldgen.config_v: Internal. Bumped when a one-time migration is needed.
